```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(Seurat); library(ggplot2); library(dplyr); library(patchwork); library(DT)})
source("R/niaid1468_helpers.R")
if (!exists("HELPERS_VERSION") || HELPERS_VERSION < 2) stop("Stale R/niaid1468_helpers.R: copy the latest version next to this QMD")
# Atomic RDS save: write to .tmp, read it back in full (fails on a truncated file), then rename into place.
# A killed job or full quota therefore leaves the previous file (or none), never a half-written one.
save_rds_atomic <- function(x, path) {
  tmp <- paste0(path, ".tmp"); on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(x, tmp)
  chk <- readRDS(tmp); ok <- identical(colnames(chk), colnames(x)); rm(chk); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))
  if (!ok) stop("Read-back check failed for ", tmp)
  if (!file.rename(tmp, path)) stop("Could not move ", tmp, " to ", path)
  invisible(path)
}
read_rds_ok <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(e) { warning("Unreadable RDS (will be rebuilt): ", path, " - ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
}
options(ggrepel.max.overlaps = Inf)
# per-chunk timing, printed to the console while rendering
knitr::knit_hooks$set(timer = function(before, options) {
  if (before) assign(".t0", Sys.time(), envir = globalenv())
  else message(sprintf("[TIMER] %-18s %6.1f min", options$label,
                       as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), get(".t0", globalenv()), units = "mins"))))
})
knitr::opts_chunk$set(timer = TRUE)
full      <- params$detail == "full"
base      <- params$base_dir
test_n    <- params$test_cells
outdir    <- file.path(base, if (test_n > 0) "01_QC_annotations_TEST" else "01_QC_annotations")
cache_dir <- file.path(outdir, "annotation_cache")
dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

.t <- Sys.time(); tick <- function(msg) { message(sprintf("[TIMER] setup: %-14s %6.1f min", msg, as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .t, units = "mins")))); .t <<- Sys.time() }
obj <- readRDS(file.path(base, "03_SingleR_fast/NIAID1468_SingleR_annotated.rds")); tick("readRDS")
# drop everything this report does not use BEFORE subsetting (subset() touches every assay/layer)
obj <- DietSeurat(obj, assays = intersect(c("RNA", "HTO"), Assays(obj)),
                  dimreducs = intersect(c("pca", "umap_merged", "umap"), Reductions(obj)),
                  graphs = NULL, scale.data = FALSE)
tick("DietSeurat")
if (test_n > 0) {
  set.seed(1468)
  by_lib <- split(colnames(obj), obj$library_id)
  keep_cells <- unlist(lapply(by_lib, function(v) sample(v, min(length(v), ceiling(test_n / length(by_lib))))))
  obj <- subset(obj, cells = keep_cells)
}
tick("subset")
obj <- prep_rna(obj); tick("prep_rna")

key <- sample_key()
ix  <- match(as.character(obj$library_id), key$library_id)
stopifnot(!anyNA(ix))
obj$DSS_day     <- key$DSS_day[ix]
obj$sample_name <- key$sample_name[ix]
obj$mouse_id    <- paste(obj$library_id, obj$HTO_classification, sep = "_")
if (!"percent.mt" %in% colnames(obj[[]]))
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^mt-")
```

```{r test-banner}
  "cells. Results are for debugging only. Use `-P test_cells:0` for the full analysis.\n:::\n")
```

## 1. Samples and QC

One row per library: design, post-filter RNA QC and HTO calling.

```{r libraries}
hto_csv <- file.path(base, "02_HTO_and_annotation/HTO_QC_compact_summary.csv")
lib <- obj[[]] |>
  group_by(library_id, sample_name, DSS_day) |>
  summarise(mice = n_distinct(mouse_id), cells = n(),
            median_UMI = median(nCount_RNA), median_genes = median(nFeature_RNA),
            median_pct_mt = median(percent.mt), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(DSS_day, sample_name)
if (file.exists(hto_csv))
  lib <- left_join(lib, read.csv(hto_csv) |>
    transmute(library_id = library, droplets = total, singlet_pct, doublet_pct, negative_pct),
    by = "library_id")
dt(lib, page = 8)
```

## 4. Endothelial selection

```{r ec-select}
m         <- norm_matrix(obj)
ec_mk     <- intersect(c("Pecam1", "Cdh5", "Kdr", "Emcn", "Vwf"), rownames(m))
marker_pos <- Matrix::colSums(m[ec_mk, , drop = FALSE] > 0) >= 2
ref_ec    <- grepl("endothel", obj$pre_SingleR_label,  ignore.case = TRUE) |
             grepl("endothel", obj$pre_SingleR_pruned, ignore.case = TRUE)
keep      <- marker_pos | ref_ec
write.csv(data.frame(cell = colnames(obj), SingleR = obj$pre_SingleR_label,
                     marker_pos, ref_ec, keep_EC = keep),
          file.path(outdir, "EC_selection_audit.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
rm(m); invisible(gc())
```

Kept **`r format(sum(keep), big.mark = ",")`** of `r format(length(keep), big.mark = ",")` cells
(≥2 of `r length(ec_mk)` pan-EC markers detected, or SingleR = endothelial).

## 5. EC reclustering and Harmony check (visual only)

```{r ec-build}
sig  <- list(res = params$ec_resolution, npcs = params$npcs, nfeat = params$ec_nfeatures,
             n = sum(keep))
ckpt <- file.path(outdir, "checkpoint_EC.rds")
ec <- NULL
if (!params$force_recluster && file.exists(ckpt)) {
  tmp <- read_rds_ok(ckpt)   # NULL if the checkpoint is truncated/corrupt -> EC object is rebuilt
  if (inherits(tmp, "Seurat") && identical(tmp@misc$sig, sig) && setequal(colnames(tmp), colnames(obj)[keep])) ec <- tmp
  rm(tmp)
}
rebuilt <- is.null(ec)
if (rebuilt) {
  dims <- seq_len(params$npcs)
  ec <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[keep])
  ec <- NormalizeData(ec, verbose = FALSE)
  ec <- FindVariableFeatures(ec, nfeatures = params$ec_nfeatures, verbose = FALSE)
  ec <- ScaleData(ec, verbose = FALSE)
  ec <- RunPCA(ec, npcs = params$npcs, verbose = FALSE)
  ec <- RunUMAP(ec, reduction = "pca", dims = dims, reduction.name = "umap_unint", verbose = FALSE)
  ec <- harmony::RunHarmony(ec, group.by.vars = "library_id", reduction.save = "harmony", verbose = FALSE)
  ec <- RunUMAP(ec, reduction = "harmony", dims = dims, reduction.name = "umap_harmony", verbose = FALSE)
  ec <- FindNeighbors(ec, reduction = "pca", dims = dims, verbose = FALSE)  # clusters use unintegrated PCA
  ec <- FindClusters(ec, resolution = params$ec_resolution, cluster.name = "EC_cluster", verbose = FALSE)
  ec@misc$mixing <- data.frame(
    embedding = c("PCA (before Harmony)", "Harmony (after)"),
    library_mixing = c(mixing_score(ec, "pca"), mixing_score(ec, "harmony")))
  ec@misc$sig <- sig
  save_rds_atomic(ec, ckpt)
}
Idents(ec) <- "EC_cluster"
# always refresh metadata carried over from the all-cell object
carry <- c("DSS_day", "sample_name", "mouse_id", grep("^pre_", colnames(obj[[]]), value = TRUE))
for (f in carry) ec[[f]] <- obj[[f, drop = TRUE]][match(colnames(ec), colnames(obj))]
```

Top row: unintegrated PCA (used for clustering). Bottom row: Harmony on library, shown for comparison only.

```{r harmony-umaps}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 9
umap_panel(ec, "umap_unint",   c("library_id", "DSS_day"), prefix = "Before Harmony:") /
umap_panel(ec, "umap_harmony", c("library_id", "DSS_day"), prefix = "After Harmony:")
```

```{r mixing}
dt(ec@misc$mixing, digits = 3, page = 5)
```

Library mixing: 1 = neighbours evenly spread over the 8 libraries. Harmony is not used downstream:
4 of 6 days are a single library, so library differences are largely true day-to-day biology.
Clusters, annotation and DE (mouse-level pseudobulk from raw counts) all use unintegrated data.

## 6. EC annotation (after reclustering)

We first compare the reclustered endothelial populations with two reference-based
annotation methods. **SingleR** supplies broad cell identities, while **Mouse Cell
Atlas (MCA)** supplies the closest matching reference labels. MCA labels may name
specific source tissues (e.g., neonatal skin, heart, pancreas, or ovary); these
are **reference origins, not evidence that the colon cells came from those tissues**.
A more specific reference label is not necessarily a more accurate colon
endothelial subtype annotation.

```{r post-annotation}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
mca2 <- annotate_mca(ec, as.character(ec$EC_cluster),
                     file.path(cache_dir, "post_MCA_predictions_cluster.csv"), params$force_annotation)
ec <- add_labels(ec, mca2, "post_MCA")

# Reference-based annotation only for this initial PI-facing report.
# Subtype assignments are deferred until the marker expression patterns are reviewed.
red_post <- "umap_unint"
umap_panel(ec, red_post, c("EC_cluster", "pre_SingleR_pruned", "post_MCA_pruned"))
```

### Reference-based annotations by EC cluster

The percentages below describe the **fraction of cells within each cluster**
assigned the displayed label, **not** a prediction confidence or probability.
SingleR annotations were generated per cell before EC reclustering; MCA
annotations were obtained using the reclustered EC populations.

```{r post-table}
tab <- cluster_summary(ec, "EC_cluster",
                       c(SingleR = "pre_SingleR_pruned", MCA = "post_MCA_pruned"))
# Keep only cluster size and the two reference labels (with their label frequencies).
# Exclude library/day composition, marker scores and provisional subtypes.
pi_cols <- intersect(c("cluster", "n", "N", "n_cells", "cells", "SingleR", "MCA"), names(tab))
stopifnot(all(c("cluster", "SingleR", "MCA") %in% pi_cols))
dt(tab[, pi_cols, drop = FALSE], page = 16)
```

### Endothelial marker expression by EC cluster

The dot plot below provides **independent biological evidence** for refining the
reference-based labels. Pan-endothelial markers help assess endothelial identity;
arterial, capillary, venous and lymphatic markers can guide subsequent subtype
annotation. Activation and non-endothelial markers help identify cell states and
possible contamination. These patterns are exploratory and **do not yet establish
final subtype labels**.

```{r dotplot}
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 6
marker_sets <- list(
  Pan_EC    = c("Pecam1", "Cdh5", "Kdr", "Emcn", "Vwf"),
  Arterial  = c("Gja5", "Sox17", "Efnb2", "Bmx"),
  Capillary = c("Plvap", "Rgcc", "Car4"),
  Venous    = c("Ackr1", "Nr2f2"),
  Lymphatic = c("Prox1", "Lyve1", "Pdpn", "Flt4"),
  Activated = c("Icam1", "Vcam1", "Sele", "Selp"),
  NonEC     = c("Ptprc", "Epcam", "Col1a1", "Dcn", "Lum"))
marker_sets <- Filter(length, lapply(marker_sets, intersect, rownames(ec)))
DotPlot(ec, features = marker_sets, group.by = "EC_cluster", assay = "RNA") +
  RotatedAxis() +
  labs(title = "Endothelial and lineage marker expression across EC clusters",
       x = "Marker genes", y = "EC cluster")
```

**Next step:** Use the dot-plot expression patterns, together with additional
cluster-specific markers, to determine whether individual clusters represent
arterial, capillary, venous or lymphatic endothelium, activated endothelial
states, or potential non-endothelial cells. SingleR and MCA are useful first-pass
references, but MCA's tissue-specific label names should not be interpreted as
validated colon endothelial subtypes.


### Kalucka colon endothelial markers: top-20/50/100 sensitivity analysis

The colon-specific marker lists are drawn from the supplied **Kalucka colon marker CSV** (seven EC subtypes, up to 649 ranks). This section compares the top 20, 50, and 100 ranked genes per subtype against the existing canonical markers, using the *same* EC checkpoint and normalized RNA expression. It does not rerun clustering or reference-based annotation, and **does not overwrite** EC subtype labels.

The top-50 result is the primary exploratory comparison; top-20 and top-100 are sensitivity checks. Stable top-ranked signatures are not proof of annotation accuracy. Gene-symbol artifacts such as `4-Sep` are excluded pending verification. The input CSV should be placed next to the QMD, or its path supplied through `KALUCKA_COLON_CSV`.

```{r kalucka-marker-comparison}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 10
marker_csv <- Sys.getenv("KALUCKA_COLON_CSV", unset = "Colon marker set table(1).csv")
if (!file.exists(marker_csv)) {
  candidates <- c("Colon marker set table.csv", file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input()), "Colon marker set table(1).csv"))
  candidates <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(candidates)) marker_csv <- candidates[[1]]
}
if (!file.exists(marker_csv)) stop("Kalucka colon CSV not found. Set KALUCKA_COLON_CSV to its full path.")
if (!"EC_cluster" %in% names(ec[[]])) stop("EC_cluster metadata missing from existing EC object")
# Preserve all ranked entries; create separate signatures for each cutoff.
marker_table <- read.csv(marker_csv, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!"Rank" %in% names(marker_table)) stop("CSV must contain a Rank column")
marker_table$Rank <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(marker_table$Rank))
marker_table <- marker_table[!is.na(marker_table$Rank), , drop = FALSE]
marker_table <- marker_table[order(marker_table$Rank), , drop = FALSE]
marker_columns <- setdiff(names(marker_table), "Rank")
cutoffs <- c(20L, 50L, 100L)
clean_genes <- function(v) {
  v <- trimws(as.character(v))
  v <- v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(v) & !grepl("^[0-9]{1,2}[-/][A-Za-z]{3}$", v)]
  unique(v)
}
kalucka_sets <- lapply(cutoffs, function(k) {
  x <- marker_table[marker_table$Rank <= k, , drop = FALSE]
  setNames(lapply(marker_columns, function(nm) clean_genes(x[[nm]])),
           make.names(marker_columns))
})
names(kalucka_sets) <- paste0("Top", cutoffs)
marker_counts <- vapply(marker_table[marker_columns], function(x) length(clean_genes(x)), integer(1))
write.csv(data.frame(subtype=names(marker_counts), available_ranked_markers=unname(marker_counts)),
          file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_colon_marker_counts.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
if (any(grepl("Sep", unlist(marker_table[marker_columns]), fixed=TRUE), na.rm=TRUE))
  cat("NOTE: possible Excel-converted gene symbols are excluded from scoring.\n")
# Preserve the baseline panel defined above; exclude Pan_EC, Activated and NonEC
# from subtype-to-subtype scoring, but retain them in the existing DotPlot.
canonical_subtypes <- marker_sets[intersect(c("Arterial", "Capillary", "Venous", "Lymphatic"), names(marker_sets))]

# Obtain the same RNA data layer for both comparisons; no re-normalization,
# re-clustering or label transfer is performed here.
DefaultAssay(ec) <- "RNA"
rna_data <- tryCatch(SeuratObject::GetAssayData(ec, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"),
                     error = function(e) stop("Normalized RNA data layer required for Kalucka comparison: ", conditionMessage(e)))
cluster_ids <- as.character(ec$EC_cluster)
if (anyNA(cluster_ids)) stop("Missing EC_cluster labels")
if (ncol(rna_data) != length(cluster_ids) || !identical(colnames(rna_data), colnames(ec))) {
  stop("RNA data columns and EC cluster labels are not aligned")
}
cluster_levels <- if (all(grepl("^[0-9]+$", unique(cluster_ids))))
  as.character(sort(as.integer(unique(cluster_ids)))) else sort(unique(cluster_ids))
cluster_fac <- factor(cluster_ids, levels = cluster_levels)

# Average normalized log-expression for each gene within each EC cluster.
# Per-gene z-scoring across clusters makes expression patterns comparable,
# but should NOT be interpreted as differential expression or classification accuracy.
all_sets <- c(setNames(canonical_subtypes, paste0("Current_", names(canonical_subtypes))),
              unlist(lapply(names(kalucka_sets), function(k) setNames(kalucka_sets[[k]], paste0("Kalucka_", k, "_", names(kalucka_sets[[k]])))), recursive=FALSE))
all_genes <- unique(unlist(all_sets, use.names = FALSE))
present <- intersect(all_genes, rownames(rna_data))
coverage <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_sets), function(nm) {
  g <- unique(all_sets[[nm]])
  data.frame(panel = if (startsWith(nm, "Kalucka_")) sub("^Kalucka_(Top[0-9]+)_.*$", "\\1", nm) else "Current",
             signature = sub("^(Current_|Kalucka_Top[0-9]+_)", "", nm),
             n_requested = length(g), n_present = sum(g %in% present),
             n_missing = sum(!g %in% present),
             missing_genes = paste(setdiff(g, present), collapse = "; "))
}))
write.csv(coverage, file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_cutoff_marker_coverage.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

if (length(present) && length(cluster_levels) > 1L) {
  cluster_cells <- split(seq_along(cluster_ids), cluster_fac, drop = TRUE)
  # Explicitly build gene x cluster matrix; vapply() may drop dimensions or
  # column names in corner cases, causing expand.grid() to have zero rows.
  avg <- do.call(cbind, lapply(cluster_cells, function(idx) {
    Matrix::rowMeans(rna_data[present, idx, drop = FALSE])
  }))
  avg <- matrix(avg, nrow = length(present), ncol = length(cluster_cells),
                dimnames = list(present, names(cluster_cells)))
  # Scale each gene across clusters; zero variance genes are assigned zero.
  z <- t(scale(t(avg)))
  z[!is.finite(z)] <- 0
  # pmin()/pmax() can strip matrix dimensions and dimnames in R.
  # Clip numeric values, then explicitly restore the gene x cluster matrix.
  z <- matrix(pmax(-2.5, pmin(2.5, as.numeric(z))),
              nrow = nrow(avg), ncol = ncol(avg),
              dimnames = dimnames(avg))
  stopifnot(is.matrix(z), identical(dim(z), dim(avg)),
            identical(rownames(z), present),
            identical(colnames(z), names(cluster_cells)))

  # Plot each signature's constituent genes, preserving published rank order.
  plot_signature_heatmap <- function(sets, panel_name) {
    dat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), function(nm) {
      genes <- intersect(unique(sets[[nm]]), present)
      if (!length(genes)) return(NULL)
      if (!length(colnames(z))) return(NULL)
      expand <- expand.grid(gene = genes, EC_cluster = colnames(z), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      if (!nrow(expand)) return(NULL)
      expand$z <- z[cbind(match(expand$gene, rownames(z)), match(expand$EC_cluster, colnames(z)))]
      expand$signature <- nm
      expand$gene_rank <- match(expand$gene, genes)
      expand
    }))
    if (is.null(dat) || !nrow(dat)) return(NULL)
    # Unique gene+signature labels handle genes occurring in multiple panels.
    dat$gene_label <- paste(dat$signature, dat$gene, sep = " | ")
    ord <- unique(dat$gene_label[order(match(dat$signature, names(sets)), dat$gene_rank)])
    dat$gene_label <- factor(dat$gene_label, levels = rev(ord))
    dat$EC_cluster <- factor(dat$EC_cluster, levels = cluster_levels)
    ggplot(dat, aes(x = EC_cluster, y = gene_label, fill = z)) +
      geom_tile() + scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B6FB6", mid = "white", high = "#B23B3B",
                                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2.5, 2.5), name = "Gene z") +
      facet_grid(signature ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
            panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.3, "lines")) +
      labs(title = panel_name, x = "EC cluster", y = NULL)
  }
  current_heatmap <- plot_signature_heatmap(canonical_subtypes, "Current canonical EC subtype markers | cluster-mean gene z-scores")
  colon_heatmap <- plot_signature_heatmap(kalucka_sets[["Top20"]], "Kalucka colon top 20 | cluster-mean gene z-scores")
  if (!is.null(current_heatmap)) {
    pdf(file.path(outdir, "EC_current_marker_heatmap.pdf"), width = 13, height = 8)
    print(current_heatmap); dev.off()
  } else cat("No current canonical markers available for heatmap.\n")
  if (!is.null(colon_heatmap)) {
    pdf(file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_colon_top20_gene_heatmap.pdf"), width = 15, height = 26)
    print(colon_heatmap); dev.off()
  } else cat("No colon reference markers available for heatmap.\n")

  # Equal-weighted average of each signature's constituent gene z-scores.
  # Scores describe cluster-level relative enrichment; they are not
  # SingleR predictions, confidence values or direct accuracy measures.
  score_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_sets), function(nm) {
    genes <- intersect(unique(all_sets[[nm]]), rownames(z))
    if (!length(genes) || !ncol(z)) return(NULL)
    gene_cluster_z <- z[genes, , drop = FALSE]
    stopifnot(length(dim(gene_cluster_z)) == 2L)
    data.frame(panel = if (startsWith(nm, "Kalucka_")) sub("^Kalucka_(Top[0-9]+)_.*$", "\\1", nm) else "Current",
               signature = sub("^(Current_|Kalucka_Top[0-9]+_)", "", nm),
               EC_cluster = colnames(z),
               mean_gene_z = base::colMeans(gene_cluster_z),
               n_genes = length(genes))
  }))
  if (is.null(score_rows) || !nrow(score_rows)) {
    stop("No signature scores could be computed; check marker coverage and EC clusters.")
  }
  write.csv(score_rows, file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_cutoff_cluster_signature_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  signature_heatmap <- ggplot(score_rows, aes(x = factor(EC_cluster, levels = cluster_levels),
                                y = signature, fill = mean_gene_z)) +
          geom_tile() + facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
          scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B6FB6", mid = "white", high = "#B23B3B", midpoint = 0) +
          theme_bw() + labs(title = "EC cluster signature enrichment | same normalized RNA data",
                            x = "EC cluster", y = NULL, fill = "Mean gene z")
  print(signature_heatmap)
  pdf(file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_cutoff_signature_scores.pdf"), width = 13, height = 9)
  print(signature_heatmap); dev.off()
  # Within each panel and cluster, show the leading signature and its
  # separation from the runner-up (exploratory ambiguity indicator).
  # Rank explicitly within each panel/cluster. Do not mix signatures across cutoffs.
  ranking <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(split(score_rows, interaction(score_rows$panel,
                                             score_rows$EC_cluster, drop=TRUE)), function(df) {
    df <- df[order(-df$mean_gene_z, df$signature), , drop=FALSE]
    data.frame(panel=df$panel[1], EC_cluster=df$EC_cluster[1],
      top_signature=df$signature[1], top_score=df$mean_gene_z[1],
      runner_up=if(nrow(df)>1) df$signature[2] else NA_character_,
      runner_up_score=if(nrow(df)>1) df$mean_gene_z[2] else NA_real_,
      score_margin=if(nrow(df)>1) df$mean_gene_z[1]-df$mean_gene_z[2] else NA_real_)
  }))
  stopifnot(all(is.na(ranking$score_margin) | ranking$score_margin >= -1e-10))
  # Stability of the leading Kalucka subtype across 20, 50, and 100.
  kal_ranks <- ranking[ranking$panel %in% paste0("Top", cutoffs), ]
  stability <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(kal_ranks, kal_ranks$EC_cluster), function(df) {
    df <- df[match(paste0("Top", cutoffs), df$panel), , drop=FALSE]
    valid <- !is.na(df$top_signature)
    data.frame(EC_cluster=df$EC_cluster[1],
      top20=df$top_signature[1], top50=df$top_signature[2],
      top100=df$top_signature[3],
      stable_across_cutoffs=all(valid) && length(unique(df$top_signature))==1,
      min_margin=if(any(valid)) min(df$score_margin[valid], na.rm=TRUE) else NA_real_)
  }))
  write.csv(stability, file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_top20_50_100_annotation_stability.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
  write.csv(ranking, file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_cutoff_cluster_top_signatures.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  # Main report: concise, clearly defined table. Keep cutoff diagnostics in CSV.
  cluster_n <- as.data.frame(table(EC_cluster = cluster_ids), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  names(cluster_n)[2] <- "n_cells"
  stability <- merge(stability, cluster_n, by="EC_cluster", all.x=TRUE, sort=FALSE)
  stability <- stability[match(cluster_levels, stability$EC_cluster), , drop=FALSE]
  stability$review <- ifelse(!stability$stable_across_cutoffs, "Cutoff-dependent",
                       ifelse(!is.na(stability$min_margin) & stability$min_margin < 0.1,
                              "Close competing scores", "Consistent across cutoffs"))
  write.csv(stability, file.path(outdir, "EC_Kalucka_annotation_review_summary.csv"), row.names=FALSE)
  pretty_label <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\.", " ", as.character(x))
    x <- sub("^capillary arterial$", "Arterial capillary", x)
    x <- sub("^capillary Aqp7 $", "Aqp7+ capillary", x)
    x <- sub("^vein Madcam1 $", "MAdCAM1+ vein", x)
    x <- sub("^capillary ([12])$", "Capillary \\1", x)
    x <- sub("^artery$", "Artery", x)
    x <- sub("^lymphatic$", "Lymphatic", x)
    x
  }
  reader_tab <- data.frame(
    `EC cluster`=stability$EC_cluster,
    `Cells`=as.integer(stability$n_cells),
    `Top Kalucka colon signature (50 genes)`=pretty_label(stability$top50),
    `Evidence from 20/50/100-gene comparison`=stability$review,
    check.names=FALSE)
  cat("\n\n#### EC subtype signatures: provisional interpretation\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(reader_tab, format="html", escape=TRUE, row.names=FALSE,
    caption="EC cluster is the Seurat reclustering ID; Cells is its size. The signature is the highest-scoring Kalucka colon marker set (top 50 genes), NOT a finalized cell identity. The final column indicates cutoff consistency or a small score margin, NOT statistical confidence."))
  cat(sprintf("\n\n**Cutoff agreement:** %d/%d EC clusters have the same leading signature with 20, 50, and 100 genes.\n\n",
              sum(stability$stable_across_cutoffs), nrow(stability)))
  flagged <- stability$EC_cluster[stability$review != "Consistent across cutoffs"]
  cat(sprintf("**Manual review priorities:** clusters %s. Compare individual marker expression and competing signatures before final annotation.\n\n",
              if(length(flagged)) paste(flagged, collapse=", ") else "none flagged by these criteria"))
} else {
  cat("Insufficient marker coverage or fewer than two EC clusters; comparison plots skipped.\n")
}

```


**How to interpret this table:** Each row represents a Seurat EC cluster. The marker-set name describes the *best-matching Kalucka colon signature* using 50 genes, not a confirmed cell identity. The evidence column summarizes whether that match persists with 20 and 100 genes; close competing scores are flagged separately. The full cutoff-by-cutoff comparison is exported to CSV, rather than crowding the main report. Agreement is not a probability or independent validation.

**Biological interpretation:** Arterial candidates (clusters 6 and 9),
MAdCAM1-associated venous candidates (4 and 8), and lymphatic candidates
(3 and 15) are consistent across tested cutoffs. Several capillary groups
are likewise stable, including the Aqp7-associated signature in cluster 10.
Clusters 0, 5, and 13 switch leading signatures across cutoffs; cluster 11
is stable but has a very narrow score margin. These warrant particular
scrutiny. Confirm assignments with **individual markers**, co-expression,
non-endothelial contamination checks, and cluster-specific expression;
DSS-induced activation must not be mistaken for a stable EC subtype.


**Detailed diagnostics:** Full signature scores, ranked first/second
signatures, marker coverage, and cutoff stability are exported as CSV files
in the analysis output directory. They are intentionally omitted from the
PI-facing HTML to avoid redundant tables. No final EC subtype annotation is
automatically written to the Seurat object.

```{r markers-full}
#| eval: !expr full
# detailed report only: top positive markers per EC cluster
mk <- FindAllMarkers(ec, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.5,
                     max.cells.per.ident = 500, verbose = FALSE) |>
  group_by(cluster) |> slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 8) |> ungroup() |>
  select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, pct.1, pct.2, p_val_adj)
write.csv(mk, file.path(outdir, "EC_cluster_top_markers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
dt(mk, page = 16)
```

```{r composition-full}
ggplot(cmp, aes(EC_cluster, percent, fill = library_id)) + geom_col() + theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Library composition of each EC cluster", x = "EC cluster", y = "%")
```

## 7. Exports

```{r exports}
final_rds <- file.path(outdir, "NIAID1468_EC_annotated_pre_post_SingleR_MCA.rds")
# Re-save unless an existing final RDS is fully readable AND carries the columns Step 2 needs.
# (Previously any existing file blocked the save, so a truncated file was never replaced.)
final_valid <- function(p) {
  x <- read_rds_ok(p)
  ok <- inherits(x, "Seurat") && all(c("EC_cluster", "post_MCA_pruned") %in% colnames(x[[]]))
  rm(x); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE)); ok
}
if (rebuilt || params$force_annotation || !file.exists(final_rds) || !final_valid(final_rds)) {
  save_rds_atomic(ec, final_rds)
  message("Saved ", final_rds, " (", round(file.size(final_rds) / 2^20), " MB, verified by full read-back)")
}
write.csv(data.frame(cell = colnames(ec), ec[[]], check.names = FALSE),
          file.path(outdir, "EC_annotation_metadata_pre_post.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
dt(data.frame(file = c(basename(final_rds), "EC_annotation_metadata_pre_post.csv",
                       "EC_selection_audit.csv", "checkpoint_EC.rds"), dir = outdir), page = 5)
```
